unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops 'As though that first scrutiny had been satisfactory' and the sentence saying Rita's tension relaxed after Tuppence's recital. Tuppence's story now produces no visible effect before 'I see'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The 'You speak like an educated girl?' question and the 'lines suggested by Mr. Carter' survive, so a reader can infer that the cover worked.

evidence.quote: It seemed to her, as she did so, that the tension of Mrs. Vandemeyer’s attitude relaxed.
As though that first scrutiny had been satisfactory, Mrs. Vandemeyer motioned to a chair.
Glibly enough, Tuppence ran through her imaginary career on the lines suggested by Mr. Carter.
Tuppence returned the lady's gaze firmly and respectfully. Mrs. Vandemeyer motioned to a chair.
It seemed to her that the tension of Mrs. Vandemeyer's attitude relaxed.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's sentence: 'It seemed to her that the tension of Mrs. Vandemeyer's attitude relaxed.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required: the interview and the V.A.D. cover are both essential.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The interview stops showing Carter's 'stick to the truth' advice working on a suspicious woman. Rita's sudden generosity reads as unmotivated, and the tension between the basilisk glance and its easing goes flat.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Rita's scrutiny and relaxation cut from the interview

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts 'Tuppence was ushered into a room on the right of the long passage'. The text jumps from Rita's offstage order to a woman at a fireplace.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Show her in then. At once.' implies that she is shown in.

evidence.quote: Tuppence was ushered into a room on the right of the long passage. A woman was standing by the fireplace.
A woman was standing by the fireplace. She was no longer in her first youth
Tuppence was ushered into a room on the right of the long passage.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the single ushering sentence before the fireplace line.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required: Rita's description and the interview are essential, and this is a dangling residue of compression.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This is a small spatial gap. Tuppence is still at the door with Annie when 'A woman was standing by the fireplace' appears, which blurs the movement inside and the reveal of the steely voice's owner.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Entrance into Rita's room omitted

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision removes Carter's 'if you choose to withdraw now no one could blame you'. It also removes 'With some reluctance she abandoned the interesting part she had sketched out for herself'. What she gives up for his advice is never stated.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'If, in spite of my warnings, you make up your mind' still implies a choice.

evidence.quote: You have given us valuable information, and if you choose to withdraw now no one could blame you.
With some reluctance she abandoned the interesting part she had sketched out for herself.
Mr. Carter's warnings passed unheeded, but she had too much common sense not to recognize the force of his arguments.
With some reluctance she abandoned the interesting part she had sketched out for herself.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the reluctance sentence from the first draft. Optionally restore 'If you choose to withdraw now no one could blame you.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required: Carter's letter and her response are essential.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The 'ignores danger but takes advice' beat becomes abstract. The comic sense that she must surrender a cherished role is lost, and the letter's 'Whichever way you decide' has a weaker offer behind it.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Carter's choice frame and Tuppence's reluctant abandonment blurred
